description: Replace a compatible kernel or activity adapter across a controlled restart. Canonical ids, receipts, and pending work survive; in-flight operations stay pinned to the binding they started under until completed or reconciled.
crash_point: none (binding swap at a controlled restart)
expected_observable: Operation ids and recorded receipts are unchanged across the swap; pending operations reconcile against their pinned component/API binding version rather than silently switching to the newly configured adapter; consumer code keeps using the same Agalma APIs; export_state/import_state round-trips with a version header and refuses incompatible versions.

fixture_refs.bindings: ledger binding records (BindingId, component_api, api_version, generation, state)
